title: Triangle Inequality: Ultrametric Triangle Inequality in p-adic Analysis

problemStatement.plain: Backfill the p-adic ultrametric triangle-inequality metadata around the rational `padicNorm`, p-adic field norm, p-adic integers, and induced ultrametric distance.
whyMatters: The ultrametric inequality is the defining geometric feature of p-adic analysis.
The formalization shows the strict strengthening from an additive triangle inequality to a maximum bound.
The result connects elementary rational p-adic norms to p-adic fields, integers, and distances.

proven: `padicNorm_ultrametric` proves the rational p-adic norm version.
`padic_ultrametric` and `padic_add_eq_max_of_ne` cover the p-adic field norm and the unequal-norm equality case.
`padicInt_ultrametric`, `padic_ultrametric_three`, and `padic_dist_ultrametric` extend the inequality to p-adic integers, three-term sums, and distance.
`abs_triangle` and `norm_triangle` remain the ordinary real/normed-space comparison points in the parent file.
open: `TriangleInequalityOQ02.lean` records zero axioms and zero sorries; the separate `TriangleInequalityOQ03.lean` sibling has one axiom.
knownResults.goal: Expose the completed p-adic ultrametric theorem and distinguish it from the sibling axiom-backed development.
